priorityList: Use Odyn's Fury on cooldown for high priority AoE damage and to trigger Mountain Thane effects.
Cast Recklessness and Avatar simultaneously to maximize your burst damage window.
Use Thunder Blast immediately if you have 2 stacks or while Avatar is active.
Cast Thunder Clap if the Whirlwind (Meat Cleaver) buff is missing to ensure your single-target attacks cleave.
Use Rampage if Enrage is about to expire or if you are at 100 or more Rage to prevent capping.
Cast Bloodbath (empowered Bloodthirst) as your highest priority filler.
Use Rampage more aggressively while Recklessness is active to maximize Rage expenditure.
Cast Thunder Clap while Avatar is active for increased AoE damage and procs.
Cast Bloodthirst to generate Rage and trigger further procs.
Use any remaining Thunder Blast charges before they expire.
Use Execute on targets below 20% health (35% if talented into Massacre) or when Sudden Death procs.
Use Thunder Clap as your primary filler for sustained AoE damage.
Cast Crushing Blow if available to generate Rage and trigger procs.
Use Rampage as a general Rage spender to maintain Enrage uptime.
Use Whirlwind only as a last resort if all other abilities, including Thunder Clap, are on cooldown.
